string-array.name: advanced_guide_bodies
string-array.item:
1. Choose providers in Accounts and sources. Pica, E-H/ExH and JM are managed separately; one provider is enough.

2. Check login status and account identity before importing. JM uses scan, preview and confirmed additive import; partial failure is not complete success.

3. Favorites are collection facts, not explicit Likes for every accompanying tag. Keep passwords, cookies and pairing tokens private. Managed web login and an ordinary external link return sessions differently.

1. Correct recommendations only when needed, not every slider. Favorite coverage is evidence, not explicit liking; missing tags remain unknown.

2. Recommendation tag scope defaults to all tags. Disable all and select by group and favorite coverage if desired; newly discovered tags stay off in selected-only mode. Disabling a tag does not hide works or bypass blocks. Changes are staged until Save; zero strongly reduces but does not block.

3. Manual private labels bind selected works. Mapped labels match ANY chosen raw tag, preserving provider identity and an independent private switch. Raw facts and frozen Visual data remain unchanged; a private style name is not an automatic classifier.

4. Phone saves rerank the cache, not new retrieval; generate separately for new candidates. Both-device tag-scheme edits require an explicit whole-scheme choice during sync. Visual reference sets are not provided yet.

5. Optional AI tag-file editing starts on Desktop: export ZIP, share with an AI of your choice, import result JSON, preview and confirm. Counts and work lists default to excluded, but preference/private names are still personal. Nothing uploads automatically. Phone receives confirmed schemes via paired sync; it has no file importer in this version. Undo cannot overwrite newer edits; generation is a separate choice.

1. Check synced Visual data first. Full indexing and model work run on Desktop, not the phone. Missing vectors mean unknown, not disliked style.

2. OFF does not rerank; SHADOW only analyzes; LIVE contributes to ranking. Only your explicit actions change mode or strength, never reading this guide.

3. Vector similarity is not reliable face, scene or fine-grained annotation. Review similar works before advanced parameters; do not repeatedly rebuild frozen indexes for ordinary recommendation issues.

1. Pair on the same LAN using QR or the fallback address and temporary code. Keep codes private.

2. Pairing success is separate from background sync completion. The phone can read Desktop downloads over LAN while Desktop is online and reachable, without another full download.

3. Phone and Desktop keep separate current recommendation cycles. Sync merges durable preferences, feedback and foundation data, not a forced identical batch. Resolve same-item conflicts explicitly. Desktop-dependent paths are unavailable while Desktop is offline.

1. Configure and test WebDAV separately, save, then check available files. Never expose credentials in screenshots.

2. Inspect the sync or upload plan before running. Local, Desktop LAN and cloud files are separate copies: one copy does not prove the others are complete.

3. Cloud deletion differs from deleting local downloads. Cloud reading while Desktop is off requires phone configuration and accessible files. This guide does not test, scan or upload.

1. Distinguish queued, running, failed and completed tasks. Inspect errors before retrying. Pause or cancellation does not erase all files.

2. Shelves organize your library. Removing a shelf entry, unfavoriting, deleting local files and deleting cloud copies have different effects; check the confirmation target.

3. Preserve data when replacing application binaries. Do not mix test databases into production or clear data as the first response to a connection error.

4. Library → Import local comics accepts your own folders or CBZ. An imported card or detail Sources and copies menu can export image pages as CBZ. It excludes accounts, history, shelves and private tags: reimport creates a new local identity, not a full restore. Cancellation or failure can leave a partial destination; check the file before deleting your only copy. Update in place rather than uninstall.

1. Profiles summarize lifetime, recent and session evidence; collection frequency is not explicit liking for every trait. Phone and Desktop recommendations are independent.

2. Shadow, evaluation, Visual QC and work-identity audits are diagnostic or experimental; some are Desktop-only and none are prerequisites for reading. Insufficient mature evidence means waiting for data, not zero accuracy.

3. Record version, exact error and trigger. Desktop audit exports can contain private catalog, preference and behavior data even without credentials: review before sharing. This guide runs no experiment.

1. Check version and update channel. Stable and Dev/RC packages differ; tests must not overwrite production data or stable OTA.

2. Prefer in-place Android updates. Stop on signature mismatch; do not uninstall and lose data just to install a new build.

3. Diagnose provider failures and taste issues separately. Cleanup, full rebuilds and model jobs need a specific reason. Reading this chapter does not check, download or install updates.

string-array.name: advanced_spotlight_step_bodies
string-array.item: Enable only a provider you intend to use. Visiting this page does not log in.
An optional Host is user-selected and is not required for local reading.
Choose which raw and personal tags participate before adjusting inference.
Edits are staged. Save is a separate decision; this guide never presses it.
Turn Visual ranking on only when intended.
Strength changes require your explicit confirmation.
Scanning starts only after you press the real scan button.
Manual pairing requires a device address and temporary code; no code is entered by the guide.
Choose among configured WebDAV destinations. The guide does not switch storage.
Select a preset to review connection options. Testing and saving still require an explicit tap.
Completed downloads and background jobs are separate views.
Inspect local download storage without deleting books.
Review current phone recommendation cycle and cached foundation.
Collected and inferred evidence are not automatic statements of preference.
Opening this page from Help is a read-only preview; no automatic check is started.
Tap to check only if you want an actual update request.
